title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
source: 10th Row Center; Nakamichi CM-300 > Sony TC-D5 > MC > DAT; DAT(c) @ 44.1 kHz > Tascam DA-20MKII > Canare Coax > Korg MR-2000S > Kimber USB 2.0 > Samplitude Pro X2 (Build 256) > TLH v2.7.0 (align on sector boundaries, flac 8, ffp) > Foobar2000 v1.3.10 Live Show Tagger; Transfer & edits by Jeff Mitchell

ai_review.summary: Nice audience‑sourced recording of a standout fall‑tour show with solid sound quality
ai_review.review: The reviewer calls this one of the fall tour’s best performances and notes that the audio is nicely captured despite being an audience source. The recording sounds good overall, making it a worthwhile listen for fans of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 4‑star review praises both the show and the sound, indicating a good performance and decent audio; limited data keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer mentions "Nice sound" with no complaints about clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments, but described as one of the fall tour's best shows.
